_comment: Add bots here. Required: slug, name, client_id, short_description. Everything else is optional. Tags drive category counts on the directory page.

bots.name: Ratot
bots.creator: Ratot-Team
bots.short_description: A Fluxer bot to help you administrate your server and have some fun.
bots.description:
Ratot is a Fluxer bot built for server administration and entertainment, created by Captain Ratax.

Features:
• Moderation: message pruning
• Fun interactions: hugs
• Customizable command prefix
• Ping checks
• Admin-level controls for bot operators

Written in JavaScript/Node.js with a MongoDB backend.

Licensed under AGPL-3.0.

bots.name: Remix
bots.creator: remix-bot
bots.short_description: Premium, high-quality, open-source music bot for Fluxer.
bots.description:
Remix is an open-source music bot for Fluxer. 100% free with no paywall features.

Sources: YouTube, Spotify, SoundCloud.

Commands:
• Playback: play, pause, resume, skip
• Queue: list, remove, clear, shuffle
• Audio: volume, loop
• Utilities: join, leave, search, stats

Written in JavaScript, MIT licensed.

bots.name: Vinto Music
bots.creator: invaliduser231
bots.short_description: Resilient self-hosted music bot with persistent queues and operational monitoring.
bots.description:
Vinto Music is a music bot for Fluxer with persistent data, queue safety, and operational monitoring.

Playback sources: YouTube, SoundCloud, Deezer, Audius, radio streams. Metadata mirroring from Spotify, Apple Music, Amazon Music, Tidal, Bandcamp, Audiomack, Mixcloud, and JioSaavn.

Features:
• Multi-voice playback per guild with separate queues per channel
• Persistent playlists, favorites, history, queue templates, and recap via MongoDB
• Gateway reconnect + heartbeat watchdogs
• Optional 24/7 mode (voice-channel-scoped)
• Built-in health checks and Prometheus metrics

Commands: play, skip, pause, queue, volume, filters, loop, seek, playlists, favorites, stations, imports, mood, charts, recap, voice profiles, reputation, template management.

bots.name: Fluxy
bots.creator: DorkyDigital
bots.short_description: A buggy in-dev moderation bot for Fluxer.
bots.description:
Fluxy is a moderation bot still in active development. Features:

• Moderation: ban, kick, warn, timeout
• Automod: anti-link, anti-spam, anti-raid, ghost-ping detection
• Admin & utility: tickets, reaction roles, verification, logging, lockdown
• Optional REST API and dashboard for self-hosters

Written in TypeScript, available both as a hosted service and for self-hosting under the Elastic License 2.0.

bots.name: Fluxer Bot
bots.creator: PerpetualPossum
bots.short_description: Reaction roles made simple. Add a role with a single command.
bots.description:
Fluxer RoleBot lets your community self-assign roles by reacting to messages. Set it up once with !add @Role <emoji> and members can opt in or out by reacting.

Commands:
  !add <@&RoleID> <emoji>   Set up a reaction role on the bound message
  !remove <@&RoleID>        Remove a reaction role
  !list                     Show all reaction roles

The role doesn't need to be mentionable. Use the raw <@&ID> markup if your client's autocomplete chip doesn't pass through correctly.

bots.name: Groovy
bots.creator: Bonnie39
bots.short_description: Lightweight music bot — YouTube playback via ffmpeg + LiveKit.
bots.description:
FluxerGroovy is a small music bot built directly on @discordjs/* and @livekit/rtc-node.

Features:
• Play music from YouTube (URLs or search queries)
• Queue management — skip, pause, resume, stop
• Streams audio through LiveKit via ffmpeg
• Uses yt-dlp under the hood

No external Lavalink / NodeLink dependency — speaks LiveKit directly.
